contentEn.description:
free wifi

 Super 1-bedroom apartment on the 6th floor front line Harbour building, in the centre of Marbella surrounded by bars, restaurants and all the city´s services. This totally renovated South-facing apartment has a private terrace with good sea and harbour views and sun almost all day.

 It has been recently renovated, with new quality fixtures and fittings throughout. Accommodation comprises: living/dining room with flat-screen TV, a relaxing sofa-bed, and doors to the furnished terrace, new modern open-plan kitchen with hob, microwave, toaster, and everything else you need to cook; bedroom with two single beds together and fitted wardrobe; and a fully tiled bathroom with luxury shower. Direct access to the promenade and from the terrace you can see the boats from the harbour. Surronding of beaches.

 🌐 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ Private A/C in the living room, bedroom and also with ceiling fans.

 🏊‍ First line beach.

 🔑 Check-in (from 4pm): the keys will be in a key box at our office. We will provide instructions prior to your arrival. Please provide an estimated arrival time at least 48h before.

 ☕ Surrounded by bar, pubs, restaurant open all day.

 🛌 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach towel) per guest included in the rental price.

 Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella!

 🚗 Book a parking spot at Parking Indigo Avenida del Mar or Francisco Norte through onepark.co
